content: Fabrikam Consumer Products (synthetic demo) uses a fictional campaign scorecard that links one promised benefit to one audience tension. Pre-launch copy tests establish comprehension; post-launch tracking measures aided awareness, consideration, repeat choice and loyalty. Creative may express purpose only when the product benefit and approved evidence remain visible.
title: Fabrikam campaign equity framework

content: Synthetic category teams build planograms from item velocity, margin, pack role and shopper mission. Entry packs receive accessible placement, premium packs receive comparison space, and new items earn temporary facings with a defined review date. The team checks availability and findability before attributing a sales change to price.
title: Retail assortment and shelf planning

content: The demo market contains fictional rivals Contoso Home Care, Northwind Essentials and Woodgrove Personal Care plus retailer-owned labels. A weekly scorecard decomposes share movement into distribution, base price, promotion, assortment and innovation. Analysts report uncertainty and never infer a competitor formula from shelf claims.
title: Synthetic competitor scorecard

content: Consumer Care records the product, lot, use pattern, symptoms and contact permission without diagnosing. Routine use questions receive approved guidance. Any report of irritation, injury, ingestion or other adverse outcome is immediately routed to Product Safety, while the case remains traceable to the original contact and approved follow-up language.
title: Consumer Care escalation procedure

content: A launch brief combines quantitative evidence such as concept scores, usage surveys and repeat rates with qualitative evidence such as interviews, diaries and observed routines. Analysts separate observed behavior from interpretation, reconcile contradictions by segment and state the unmet need in language that formulation and marketing teams can test.
title: Consumer evidence synthesis

content: The synthetic digital-shelf dashboard tracks search rank, content completeness, rating coverage, price consistency and availability. Teams first correct missing stock and malformed item data, then test titles, images and benefit ordering. Conversion experiments use a fixed audience and period so search or media effects are not confused with availability recovery.
title: Digital shelf conversion signals

content: A governed content assistant may draft channel variants from approved claims and tone rules. It cannot invent substantiation, comparative claims or consumer testimonials. A marketer reviews every output, Legal approves regulated wording, and the asset record stores prompt version, source claims, reviewer and release status.
title: Governed AI content workflow

content: In the fictional HarborMart account plan, supplier and retailer agree annual goals for assortment, promotion, retail media and on-time supply. Each goal has an owner, baseline and review cadence. Quarterly reviews distinguish joint growth from forward-buying and record corrective actions when shelf availability or service misses the threshold.
title: HarborMart joint business planning

content: Channel planning allocates a synthetic budget across video, search, social and retail media. Reach and frequency define exposure quality; holdout tests estimate incrementality; marketing-mix models provide longer-horizon context. Planners do not credit a channel for conversions that would have occurred without exposure.
title: Channel mix and incrementality

content: The demo price-pack ladder includes entry, core, premium and bulk offers tied to distinct shopping missions. Revenue Growth Management evaluates unit economics, pack-size gaps, channel fit and own-price elasticity before changing list price or promotion depth. The recommendation reports both net-revenue and margin effects.
title: Price-pack architecture method

content: Text analytics clusters fictional reviews and care transcripts by topic, sentiment and product variant. A spike is treated as a signal, not proof: analysts verify sample size, lot concentration and survey or sales corroboration. Confirmed themes inform product briefs, service scripts or a quality investigation.
title: Review signal triangulation

content: Promotion analysis compares observed volume with a documented no-promotion baseline, subtracts funding and execution costs, and adjusts for cannibalization, forward-buying and post-event dips. Profitable incremental demand requires positive contribution after those effects; shipment loading alone is not counted as consumer lift.
title: Trade promotion incrementality
